## Execution tips

- Grip opposite straight sidewalls in the upper-middle of the can, avoiding the rolled top and bottom rims. Open slightly wider than the local diameter and confirm the fingers surround the body before closing to avoid one-sided pushing or slipping.
- Keep the can upright during transport, and lift its base clear of the box rim before moving it sideways inside, avoiding a collision that could push the plastic box.
- Working space inside the box opening is narrow. Orient fingers using gaps along its long dimension and leave opening space to avoid squeezing box walls or toppling an already placed can.
- During release, let the bottom of the can rest on the box floor first, then open the gripper gently. Withdraw in a direction without contact to avoid dropping, tipping, or lifting the can with the fingers.
